# AI Contract Review Software

> I built four pages for aicontractreviewsoftware.com: the ranked guide (index.html), methodology.html, about.html and a pricing comparison (ai-contract-review-pricing.html). The guide ranks 13 active AI contract review products: 1 Spellbook, 2 LegalOn, 3 Ironclad, 4 Luminance, 5 Harvey, 6 Kira by Litera, 7 Juro, 8 Gavel Exec, 9 LinkSquares, 10 LegalSifter ReviewPro, 11 Sirion, 12 Docusign Iris, 13 Leah (formerly ContractPodAi). Each entry was checked against the vendor's own site on 2026-11-09, except Sirion, whose site blocked our reader. Sirion's details come from its own pages as relayed by our search tool, and the page says so. Only two vendors publish exact prices. Gavel Exec is $160 per user per month or $1,740 per user per year, and Gavel was acquired by Relativity in June 2026. LegalSifter ReviewPro has a free trial but no price we could confirm. Everyone else sells by quote. Three status changes are shown: Robin AI is excluded because the company was broken up in late 2025 and early 2026; Evisort is now part of Workday; Lexion is part of Docusign. Every page includes schema.org JSON-LD that matches what's on the page: WebSite and Organization, ItemList, FAQPage, and an Article/AboutPage for the methodology and about pages. The site makes no claims of hands-on testing. The sibling link is bestenterpriseagentplatforms.com. It's only a moderate fit, because none of the sibling sites covers legal or contract software. No downloadable files were requested, so none were written to out/attachments.

- [Best AI Contract Review Software (2026): 13 Tools Ranked](https://aicontractreviewsoftware.com/): Independent 2026 ranking of AI contract review software: Spellbook, LegalOn, Ironclad, Luminance, Harvey, Kira and more, with pricing, drawbacks and an FAQ.
- [AI Contract Review Software Pricing (2026): What Vendors Publish](https://aicontractreviewsoftware.com/ai-contract-review-pricing.html): What AI contract review tools cost in 2026: published prices, quote-only vendors, trials, usage caps and questions to ask before you sign.
- [How We Research and Rank AI Contract Review Software](https://aicontractreviewsoftware.com/methodology.html): How aicontractreviewsoftware.com researches and ranks AI contract review tools: official sources, current-status checks and stated criteria. No hands-on testing.
- [About AI Contract Review Software (aicontractreviewsoftware.com)](https://aicontractreviewsoftware.com/about.html): aicontractreviewsoftware.com is an independent research site that compares AI contract review tools from public, official sources. No hands-on testing claims.
